topic: IELTS Speaking Part 1: do you like your city?

script.title: IELTS Speaking Part 1: Do you like your city?

lines.text: I said, yes. Then… silence. Oops.
I really do, because there's always something going on, like the night markets.
So: a short answer, a reason with because, and one detail.
Kit's tip: answer, reason, example. Two or three sentences is enough for Part 1.
